## Cordless Water Flosser for Home and Travel

Refresh your daily oral care with this cordless water flosser. Its compact, rechargeable design lets you clean between teeth and along the gumline wherever you are, from the bathroom sink to a hotel room.

### Adjustable Water Pressure for Comfortable Cleaning

Choose strong or pulse mode, or activate DIY mode to set your own pressure from 20 to 140 PSI. The gear-sliding touch button makes it simple to find the level that feels right, whether you have sensitive teeth or are new to water flossing.

### Portable Design That Fits Your Routine

At a compact size, this flosser fits easily on a counter or in a travel bag. The removable reservoir comes off for easier packing and refilling, so you can keep your routine going on the go.

### Waterproof Build and Replacement Jets

With IPX7 waterproof construction, the flosser is designed to withstand regular rinsing. Four replacement jets are included, so everyone in the household can use their own tip.

### Start Your Fresh Routine Today

Add a water flosser to your daily care and enjoy a thorough clean at home or away. Order your cordless water flosser today and find the pressure setting that works best for you.
